paper.ref: Kautz D. J., Cao X. et al., Adv. Mater. 2025, 37, 2503365
paper.corr: Wu Xu（PNNL）；HUGS 库存定量 Meng 组
paper.group_note: DME/2-MeTHF/TFEO 2:1:1 三元溶剂（DMFN，LiTFSI 0.6–1.2 M）对 E-baseline（1 M LiTFSI DME/DOL 1:1），均含 2 wt% LiNO3。第 100 圈后用 HUGS 直接测硫与金属锂库存（方案 3 §2 近邻）。原文前后不一：正文写面容量 4 mAh/cm²，SI 写硫载量 4 mg/cm²（按 SI 记）；Li2S6 饱和浓度一处写 DME-DOL 2:1、SI 写 1:1；软包 1C 写成 '1000 mA cm-2'。扣式用 250 µm 锂，软包 100 µm 锂

EB.name: E-baseline：1 M LiTFSI DME/DOL 1:1 + 2 wt% LiNO3
EB.label: 常规
EB.quote: In comparison, the conventional electrolyte of 1 m LiTFSI in DME/DOL at 1:1 volume ratio with 2 wt.% LiNO3 was also blended and named as E-baseline

D06.name: 0.6M-DMFN（DME/2-MeTHF/TFEO 2:1:1）
D06.label: 适中溶剂化
D06.quote: DME, 2-MeTHF and TFEO were blended in a 2:1:1 volume ratio with 2 wt.% LiNO3 (a typical additive to passivate LMA and suppress PS shuttling eﬀect).[42] LiTFSI salt concentration in the range of 0.6–1.2 m was investigated in this work

D08.name: 0.8M-DMFN（DME/2-MeTHF/TFEO 2:1:1）
D08.label: 适中溶剂化
D08.quote: DME, 2-MeTHF and TFEO were blended in a 2:1:1 volume ratio with 2 wt.% LiNO3 (a typical additive to passivate LMA and suppress PS shuttling eﬀect).[42] LiTFSI salt concentration in the range of 0.6–1.2 m was investigated in this work

D10.name: 1.0M-DMFN（DME/2-MeTHF/TFEO 2:1:1）
D10.label: 适中溶剂化
D10.quote: DME, 2-MeTHF and TFEO were blended in a 2:1:1 volume ratio with 2 wt.% LiNO3 (a typical additive to passivate LMA and suppress PS shuttling eﬀect).[42] LiTFSI salt concentration in the range of 0.6–1.2 m was investigated in this work

descriptors.scale: Raman TFSI⁻ 峰：溶剂分隔离子对（SSIP）比例排序
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=SSIP 多、溶剂化强）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. 2b、S5）；E-baseline SSIP 最多，DMFN 中 CIP/AGG 随盐浓度升高而增加；CMD 显示各 DMFN 溶剂化结构相同
descriptors.quote: The peak analysis of the coordination environment of LiTFSI (Figure 2b) reveals that E-baseline has the highest degree of solvent separated ion pairs (SSIPs), even when compared to the DMFN with lower LiTFSI concentration. The intensity of the peak for contact ion pairs (CIPs) and aggregates (AGGs) increases with increasing LiTFSI concentration of the DMFN electrolytes

descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是两种溶剂混合物（不含 LiTFSI、LiNO3）中的 Li2S6 饱和浓度，按溶剂映射
descriptors.scale: Li2S6 饱和浓度（元素分析换算）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Tables S3–S4）；作者说含盐电解液中实际浓度会更低；DME-DOL 比例正文写 2:1、SI 写 1:1
descriptors.method: 元素分析（饱和溶液 S 含量换算）
descriptors.temp_note: 55 °C 搅拌 20 h 制备饱和液，测量温度未写
descriptors.quote: the maximum concentrations of Li2S6 in the two solvent systems for the baseline and DMFN electrolytes were analyzed and calculated to be 0.83 m for DME-DOL (2:1 by vol) and 0.38 m for DME-2MeTHFTFEO (2:1:1 by vol)

descriptors.mapping_note: Li2S6 加入电解液本身（含 LiTFSI、LiNO3）
descriptors.scale: Li2S6 在电解液中的溶液颜色深浅（定性）
descriptors.unit: 序号（仅表次序；大=溶解多）
descriptors.comparable_note: 同篇同法（Fig. S7a），定性；元素分析总 S（Table S2）不完全随浓度单调（0.8M 最低），作者说元素分析无法给出 Li2S6 浓度
descriptors.quote: The concentration of LiTFSI also aﬀects the degree of LiPS solubility as the color of the Li2S6 solution is lighter with increasing the LiTFSI concentration from 0.6 to 1.2 M in the DMFN electrolytes

C1.desc: Li‖Cu 改进 Aurbach 法（QT 5 mAh/cm²、QC 1 mAh/cm²、n = 10；75 µL）
C1.quote: The average Li CE was measured in the setup of Li||Cu configuration, with Li as anode and Cu as cathode, using the CE protocol (method 3 with QT of 5 mAh cm−2, QC of 1 mAh cm−2 and n of 10)

C2.desc: Li‖S 扣式倍率测试（4 mg/cm²、E/S 8、250 µm Li、25 °C）
C2.rate_note: 充电倍率或放电倍率单独递增（另一侧固定）
C2.quote: The obtained slurry was casted onto aluminum foil with a S loading of 4 mg cm-2 … 250-µm thick Li foil received from MSE supplies … electrolyte/sulfur (E/S) ratio of 8 µL mg-1-S for Li||S cells were applied

C3.desc: Li‖S 扣式 C/5 长循环（4 mg/cm²、E/S 8、250 µm Li、25 °C；C/20 化成两圈）
C3.quote: The Li||S cell cycling stability was tested within a voltage range of 1.7–2.8 V at C/10 or C/5 after 2 formation cycles at C/20 in the voltage range of 1.8-2.8 V

C4.desc: Li‖S 扣式自放电 / 日历测试（充电态静置 168 h × 28 次，C/10，25 °C；4 mg/cm²、E/S 8、250 µm Li）
C4.rate_note: C/20 化成两圈后，C/10 充电 → 静置 168 h → C/10 放电，重复 28 次
C4.quote: For the self-discharge of the Li||S cells, the cells were first performed for 2 formation cycles at C/20 in 1.8-2.8 V, then charged to 2.8 V at C/10 and followed with a 168-h rest, and after that discharged to 1.7 V at C/10 and repeated for 28 intervals

C5.desc: 1 Ah 软包（4 mg/cm²、E/S 约 5.2、100 µm Li、C/10、25 °C）
C5.quote: The cells have S electrode loading of 4 mg-S cm-2, Li electrode of 100 µm thick, and E/S ratio at ~5.2 µL (mg-S)-1

comparisons.author_judgement: 2-MeTHF 与 TFEO 共溶剂提高与锂的稳定性
comparisons.reason_quote: The improved Li CE in DMFN electrolytes over Ebaseline can be attributed to the 2-MeTHF and TFEO co-solvents which have been previously reported to improve stability with Li metal
comparisons.quote: The maximum CE of 99.66% was obtained for 1.0M-DMFN. This is much higher than 99.19% obtained for E-baseline

comparisons.author_judgement: 长链→短链转化是放电的速率限制步骤；E-baseline 在 C/3 已出现第二平台起点的电压凹陷
comparisons.rate_protocol: 放电倍率逐级递增（充电倍率固定）
comparisons.quote: nearly all electrolytes showed a sudden capacity drop when the discharge rate was increased to C/2, except for the 0.6M-DMFN electrolyte which was able to give a reasonable capacity until the discharge rate was increased to 1C

comparisons.point: 充电 C/5–1C（放电倍率固定）
comparisons.author_judgement: 充电倍率不是限制因素
comparisons.rate_protocol: 充电倍率逐级递增（放电倍率固定）
comparisons.note: 原句是所有电解液都重合，取 1.0M-DMFN 为代表
comparisons.quote: The E-baseline and DMFN electrolytes had an initial diﬀerence in capacity during the ﬁrst few cycles at the initial C/10 rate but quickly began to overlap during the C/5 charge rate. There is no noticeable drop in capacity with increasing C-rate until charging at 1C with the capacities for all electrolytes remaining overlapped

comparisons.unit: mAh/g（第一放电平台容量，越高越好）
comparisons.author_judgement: DMFN 减少长链多硫化物，降低总容量；随盐浓度升高第一平台容量继续下降
comparisons.reason_quote: The moderately solvating DMFN electrolytes reduce the amount of long-chain PSs in the electrolytes, which in turn reduces the overall capacity of the LSBs
comparisons.quote: there is a noticeable decrease in the speciﬁc capacity from E-baseline to the DMFN electrolytes and the speciﬁc capacity decreases with increasing salt concentration of the DMFN electrolytes

comparisons.author_judgement: E-baseline 黏度低、正极润湿更好
comparisons.reason_quote: While Ebaseline had a higher initial capacity because of low viscosity and more wettability of cathodes
comparisons.quote: While Ebaseline had a higher initial capacity because of low viscosity and more wettability of cathodes, the DMFN electrolytes showed signiﬁcantly improved cycling stability and CE

comparisons.val_src_A: 直接（300 圈时保持 81.3%，下限值）
comparisons.val_src_B: 计算（作者称寿命为 E-baseline 的两倍）
comparisons.author_judgement: E-baseline 100 圈后容量迅速衰减、极化增大、过充，与硫和锂两侧反应都强
comparisons.reason_quote: highlighting the high reactivity of Ebaseline with both S and Li electrodes
comparisons.note: B 的 150 圈由'cycle life doubled'反推，非原文直接给出
comparisons.quote: LSBs with 1.0M-DMFN can retain 81.3% capacity after 300 cycles at a C/5 charge/discharge rate, doubled the cycle life from the baseline electrolyte

comparisons.note: 原句是 DMFN 整体对 E-baseline
comparisons.quote: the DMFN electrolytes showed signiﬁcantly improved cycling stability and CE

Over a period of 250 cycles, the voltage proﬁles of E-baseline containing LSBs showed signiﬁcant growth in cell polarization, overcharging of the cells, and rapid capacity degradation after 100 cycles … with the 1.0MDMFN containing cells showing the least (or no signiﬁcant) polarization or decrease in capacity between the 1st and 250th cycles at C/5 rate

comparisons.author_judgement: E-baseline 中硫几乎全以多硫化物存在并持续溶出
comparisons.reason_quote: the S was primarily converted to LiPSs and continuously dissolved in the electrolyte leading to continuous side reactions and accelerated loss of S from the electrode
comparisons.note: 原文给的是不可逆硫损失 45.3% / 23.1%，此处换成保留率以统一'越高越好'；剩余硫中 E-baseline 92.6% 为多硫化物，1.0M-DMFN 63.3% 为 S8
comparisons.quote: When cycled in E-baseline, the amount of irreversible loss of active S material from the electrode is almost double of S loss in 1.0M-DMFN at 45.3% and 23.1%, respectively

retention for Li0 after 100 cycles reveals that 1.0M-DMFN cycled Li0 has a lower amount of irreversible Li0 consumption that is assigned to the side reactions in the formation of the SEI, Li2S, and Li2S2 and has improved the overall Li0 retention

comparisons.author_judgement: 最佳盐浓度在 0.8–1.0 M 之间
comparisons.quote: with the 0.8MDMFN exhibiting the highest speciﬁc capacity among the DMFN electrolytes and the 1.0M-DMFN electrolyte the best cycling stability having a high-capacity retention of 81.3% (604 mAh g−1) after 300 cycles

with the 0.8MDMFN exhibiting the highest speciﬁc capacity among the DMFN electrolytes and the 1.0M-DMFN electrolyte the best cycling stability having a high-capacity retention of 81.3% (604 mAh g−1) after 300 cycles

comparisons.val_src_A: 直接（约值，各 DMFN 概括）
comparisons.author_judgement: 多硫化物溶解受抑、两极钝化层更稳
comparisons.quote: The E-baseline containing cell had a signiﬁcant voltage decay after 50 h into the ﬁrst calendaring period and the voltage decreased to 2.2 V after the ﬁrst week with a large drop in capacity (34.2%) … All DMFN cells had a considerably less drop in their discharge capacities of ≈8% for all concentrations after the ﬁrst calendaring period

comparisons.point: 28 个一周静置周期累计（B 不含初期损失）
comparisons.val_src_B: 直接（'another'，另计于初期损失之外）
comparisons.note: E-baseline 的 23.5% 是初期损失之外'另外'的损失，口径与 A 的 5.9% 不完全一致，但方向不受影响
comparisons.quote: The DMFN electrolytes also demonstrate excellent stability during the calendar aging tests, with only 5.9% capacity loss over 28 one-week resting intervals, while the baseline electrolyte has serious capacity loss in the initial cycles and another 23.5% loss during the 28-week’s calendar test

comparisons.reason_quote: The lower specific energy of the 0.8M-DMFN cell is due to its lower initial specific capacity
comparisons.quote: The specific energy at C/20 of the two pouch cells without counting the pouch weight is 310 Wh kg-1 for E-baseline and 290 Wh kg-1 for 0.8M-DMFN

comparisons.point: C/10 循环（E-baseline 40 圈后过电位大）
comparisons.author_judgement: E-baseline 副反应带来额外充电容量、CE 低，最终电池失效
comparisons.reason_quote: because the extra charging capacity from unwanted side reactions leads to low Coulombic eﬃciency ultimately to cell death
comparisons.quote: the 0.8M-DMFN and E-baseline electrolytes were evaluated in 1-Ah pouch cells and the preliminary cycling results shown in Figure S18 (Supporting Information) also indicate the 0.8M-DMFN shows better cycling stability than E-baseline where the latter exhibits large overpotential after 40 cycles
